concepts.gloss_en: The Tablets (of the Covenant), whose length and breadth are six — associated with the letter vav

members.note: representative; the Tablets of the Covenant
same referent — the Luchot (arm=6, width=6, בחינת וו); indefinite/construct form but denotes the same Tablets across usages

concepts.gloss_en: Maluach — 'salty' / the saltbush plant, glossed as tears (salty waters); a distinct word, not 'tablets'

members.note: different lexeme (mem-prefixed root, 'salty'); בחינת דמעות/מים מלוחים — no semantic overlap with לוחות, only surface-letter resemblance

notes: The mechanical pass conflated מלוח (salty/tears) with לוחות (Tablets) on orthographic similarity only; they are unrelated concepts. הלוחות and לוחות both denote the Tablets of the Covenant and are merged as likely.
